description:
World entities: animals, NPCs, resource nodes. One page of world entities (anything not tied to one monument), alphabetical. Each carries `slug`,
`display_name`, `is_npc`, `npc_hp` (null for resources) and `icon_url`. Cached for one hour.

kind.description: `npc` = anything with hit points (animals, scientists, bosses, vehicles); `resource` = nodes, trees, barrels and other harvestables.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the display name.

name: search_world_entities
title: World entities: animals, NPCs, resource nodes
